source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Iustificéris, Dómine, * in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
text.en: O Lord, Thou shalt be justified * when Thou speakest, and be clear when Thou art judged.

text.la: Dóminus * tamquam ovis ad víctimam ductus est, et non apéruit os suum.
text.en: The Lord was brought as a lamb * to the slaughter, and He opened not His mouth.

text.la: Contrítum est * cor meum in médio mei, contremuérunt ómnia ossa mea.
text.en: Mine heart is broken within me * all my bones tremble.

text.la: Exhortátus es * in virtúte tua, et in refectióne sancta tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, Thou hast spoken unto us * in thy strength, and in thy Holy Banquet.

text.la: Oblátus est * quia ipse vóluit, et peccáta nostra ipse portávit.
text.en: He was offered up because He willed it * and He bore our sins.

text.la: Tráditor autem * dedit eis signum, dicens: Quem osculátus fúero, ipse est, tenéte eum.
text.en: Now he that betrayed Him * gave them a sign, saying: Whomsoever I shall kiss, That Same is He: hold Him fast.
